description:
These half circle khaprail tiles are flat clay roof tiles with a rounded lower edge, made by Pak Clay in Lahore, that lap in rows to give a roof a scalloped, fish scale pattern.

## How they look
Each tile is flat with a semicircular bottom edge. Laid in overlapping courses, the rounded edges form rows of scallops, the look often called fish scale roof tiles. It is a decorative profile that tends to draw the eye, so it suits roofs that are seen up close.

## Where they work
- **Villas and farmhouses** with pitched roofs that face the street.
- **Gazebos, porches and turrets**, where scalloped clay roof tiles add detail to a small area.
- **Decorative bands** on a larger roof, mixed with a plainer tile.

A decorative khaprail roof in fired clay is a traditional choice in Pakistan; clay tends to hold its colour without repainting, and a pitched tiled roof can help keep heat off the slab below when it is ventilated properly.

## Good to know
- Material: fired clay
- Profile: flat with a half circle edge
- Category: khaprail roof tiles
- Size, colour and coverage per square foot: confirm on enquiry

Flat tiles depend on overlap and slope to shed rain, so have your roofer or engineer confirm the pitch, battens and underlay for your roof. Read our guide on [how khaprail tiles are installed](/blog/how-khaprail-roof-tiles-are-installed-slope-battens-and-overlap).

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to see the shape and finish in hand, then send your roof area and city for a dated quote. Compare the [flat rectangular khaprail tile](/products/flat-rectangular-khaprail-tiles) or browse all [khaprail tiles](/categories/khaprail-tiles).

faqs.q: What is the price of half circle khaprail tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the quantity, the area to cover and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: What roof slope do flat khaprail tiles need?
faqs.a: Flat tiles shed water through overlap, so they generally need a steeper pitch than curved profiles. The right slope depends on your roof design; have your roofer or engineer confirm it before ordering.

faqs.q: Half circle or Spanish khaprail tiles: which looks better?
faqs.a: Half circle tiles give a fine, scalloped surface that suits decorative roofs. Spanish (S-shaped) tiles give bold waves and a Mediterranean look. Compare samples and photos of finished roofs before choosing.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Flat Half Circle Khaprail" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
